name: mockly-clients-workspace-root
description: npm workspace root tying together the Node client packages that depend on each other's exact versions within this repo (@dever-labs/mockly-cli, @dever-labs/mockly-testcontainers, @dever-labs/mockly-driver). This lets npm resolve those intra-repo dependencies via local workspace links instead of the npm registry, so clients/package-lock.json can be bumped directly via release-please's `extra-files` jsonpath mechanism (see release-please-config.json) and stay consistent with version bumps before the bumped packages are actually published. The OS/CPU-restricted mockly-driver-* platform sub-packages are intentionally NOT listed as workspace members (npm/cli#6138: npm workspaces have no way to treat an os/cpu-restricted member as optional, which forces --force on every install); instead `overrides` below links them locally without that bug.
